prompts.equipment:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE production game-prop sprite sheet, square, 2048 by 2048, with a precise 4 by 4 equal-cell layout. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their richly painted 1990s superhero animation look closely: angular confident ink contours, brushed/gouache texture, believable bevels and metal scuffs, deep indigo cast shadows, amber practical-light highlights and cool teal reflected edges. These must look like the actual equipment taken out of those illustrated scenes, NOT simplified vector icons, app icons, emoji, flat symbols, glossy 3D renders, badges, stickers or placeholders.
Entire sheet has genuine transparent alpha; no background, frames, labels, checkerboard, lettering, people or watermark. Each object is a separate richly drawn three-quarter-view prop centered within its equal square cell, with at least 12 percent empty padding on ALL sides and no overlap across cell boundaries. Consistent warm light from upper left. No contact pedestal or square backdrop.
Exact row-major contents, one prop per cell:
Row 1: a folded paper city map with blue route drawings; a sturdy retro handheld radio with aerial; a well-used metal wrench beside a screwdriver; a brass mechanical stopwatch.
Row 2: a little stack of brass budget tokens; two sturdy book-delivery supply crates; a physical three-column work-card board with small blank colored cards; a folded-out sturdy teal rain umbrella.
Row 3: a retro paper-card scanner with a direction card inserted; a friendly compact four-rotor delivery drone with no face or weapons; a clipboard with three large drawn check marks and no words; a handsome amber street-direction sign on a short post with no words.
Row 4: the squat four-wheel book delivery rover from the reference scene, loaded with books, no robot driver; a sorting tray of bolts, washers and metal spare parts; a comfortable purple-and-teal art-deco armchair; a low art-deco message console with a small glowing screen and low reachable buttons.
Maintain the reference's craftsmanship, painted material surfaces, atmospheric amber/blue lighting and clear silhouettes at small size. Each item must be complete and fully inside its cell.
prompts.hub:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished wide 3:2 game background illustration for the Hero Hub. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Create a richly painted, detailed production background that belongs in exactly the same original 1990s superhero animated city as those references. Dramatic art-deco architecture, confident angled ink lines, brushed gouache textures, indigo stone and steel, teal edge light, warm amber windows, purple upholstery, welcoming sunset evening. NOT a diagram, vector illustration, isometric toy, flat UI graphic or simplistic building.
No characters anywhere: this is the setting where players see their saved furnishing choices. Near-frontal slight high viewpoint, three elegant open-front arched bays inside the ground floor of the Hero Hub, a city skyline glimpsed behind. Left bay has a genuinely clear, wide accessible entry path with subtle gold floor guide lines. Center bay has a low handsome message desk with reachable buttons and a glowing retro screen. Right bay has a quiet restful seating nook with two purple art-deco armchairs and a plant. Warm overhead fixtures and crafted architectural detailing. The building opens onto a broad stone courtyard along the bottom.
This background is designed to receive transparent painted props later, so use these intentional empty placement areas:
- An empty unlettered dark rectangular sign mounting area centered above the arches, around x50%, y17%, width32%, height9%. NO WELCOME text or sign ornament baked in.
- A small bare wall area in the left bay around x30%, y45% for an optional framed city map. Do NOT paint a map.
- A bare low workbench at the far left side around x14%, y70% for sorted parts. Do not obstruct the accessible path.
- Open ground at far left front x7%, y79% for an optional low street sign.
- An empty patch of courtyard at bottom right x82%, y87%, about 23% wide, for an optional small drone landing pad. Do NOT paint the landing pad.
Architecture should fill the frame and be substantial, full painted detail rather than empty flat shapes. Keep floors, work surfaces and room boundaries plausible and clean. No readable writing, numbers, labels, logos, banners, watermark, people or robots. This must be beautiful game background artwork matching the reference lighting and rendering.
prompts.hub_clean: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep this beautiful painted 1990s superhero Art Deco hub illustration exactly the same: same composition, camera, size, three arches, city, lighting, colors, texture, low message desk, quiet seats and clear path. Change ONLY the small workbench at the left of the image. Remove the metal cylinders, mini drawers, and all loose items sitting ON TOP of that far-left low workbench, so its wooden/metal tabletop is empty and ready to receive selectable parts in the game. Retain the workbench itself, its legs/cabinets and its existing location and shadows. Carefully restore the empty wall behind the removed tabletop objects in matching painted texture. Do not remove or change anything else. No new items, no people, no labels, no writing, no watermark.
prompts.hub_props:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE transparent game prop sprite sheet, square, precise 3 by 3 equal-square-cell layout. Image 1 is the destination SCENE/STYLE reference, image 2 shows the game's original hero team for the tiny painted portrait design. Neither is an edit target. Produce richly hand-painted cutout props that naturally belong in the first reference scene: same 1990s cel-animation craftsmanship, brushed gouache textures, warm amber light from upper left, indigo cast shadows, brass fittings, cool teal edges, slight elevated frontal viewpoint. Do NOT use a flat icon, sticker, badge, logo or vector style. Genuine transparent alpha on entire canvas, no opaque squares or backgrounds, labels, grid lines or watermark. Each item centered in its equal cell with transparent breathing room and never crossing the cell boundary. Complete objects, no clipping.
Exact row-major contents:
Row 1 cell 1: a small short brass street-sign post with a friendly amber right-pointing direction plaque, no writing, front three-quarter view, short sturdy base.
Row 1 cell 2: a handsome small flat brass-and-amber wall-mounted entrance placard with a right-pointing arrow and NO writing, no post, frontal view.
Row 1 cell 3: a small freestanding framed paper city map with clearly drawn blue streets, sheltered by its own dark teal shade canopy, no readable words, frontal view and sturdy short stand.
Row 2 cell 1: a small thin brass wall frame holding a paper city map with clearly drawn blue streets, frontal view, no words, no stand.
Row 2 cell 2: a grouped arrangement of three shallow metal sorting bowls holding bolts, washers and screws, seen slightly from above, on an INVISIBLE tabletop, no actual table or background.
Row 2 cell 3: a neat cream paper mat with drawn outlines for bolts, washers and screws, with a few corresponding real parts arranged on it, seen slightly from above, no words, no actual table.
Row 3 cell 1: ONLY an elegant WELCOME lettering design in amber-gold paint with little star drawings on both ends, to sit INSIDE the existing blank mounting plaque in the reference scene. Extremely wide and short, about 6 to 1 width-to-height, filling 90 percent of cell width but just 15 percent of cell height. NO surrounding frame, board, banner, rectangle or background. Exact single word WELCOME.
Row 3 cell 2: ONLY a matching extremely wide short WELCOME painted lettering design, same scale, with three tiny painted cameo portraits of the original friendly hero team from image 2 beside the letters: curly-haired young hero, bob-haired goggled engineer, little single-armed wheeled robot. Bust/cameo portraits only, no bodies or limbs. About 6 to 1 width-to-height; 90 percent of cell width, 15 percent of cell height. NO frame, board, rectangle or background. Exact single word WELCOME.
Row 3 cell 3: a small circular brass-edged dark teal delivery-drone landing platform, lying HORIZONTALLY on the courtyard floor seen at the same perspective as image 1, so its outline is an ellipse. A pale circle and cross mark on the pad, a low physical rim and subtle amber guide lights. No aircraft, drone, poles or writing.
Do not add other objects. Keep all 9 cells separate. These are finished production art overlays, not a diagram.
prompts.hub_plan: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide 3:2 finished painted game illustration for the PLANNING stage of the Hero Hub. Image 1 is the exact building DESIGN reference. Image 2 is the rendering STYLE reference. Both are references, not edit targets. Paint a substantial cream architectural plan sheet of the first image's three-arched Art Deco hub laid on the engineer's handsome worktable in the same original 1990s superhero cartoon world as image 2. Three-quarter slightly elevated camera; the plan sheet fills most of the image. The sheet contains a carefully drawn blue-ink architectural elevation and simple floor-plan diagram of that same three-bay building, showing the clear left entry path, low central message desk and right quiet seating area. It is obviously a drawing of work still to be built, not a miniature finished building. Empty central sign mounting area, no landing pad. Accurate plausible drawing lines, no nonsense text or labels. Beautiful detailed painterly craftsmanship, textured paper, inked contours, brass ruler, mechanical pencil, a few quiet metal drafting tools at the margins, warm amber task lamp glow and cool indigo/teal nighttime workshop shadows. A little blurred Art Deco workshop background with warm windows, no people, no robots, no characters, no additional diagrams unrelated to the hub. No text, typography, logos, watermark or UI. Make the physical surfaces, lighting and paint texture match the existing game art exactly.
